214529|859a347e.name: Brave Stonetorch
214529|859a347e.text:
Now that I've seen this land and have heard the sound of the earth here, I think I am glad I made the journey. 

Ah, forgive me. I am thinking aloud. I am called Stonetorch, and I come here seeking knowledge of a brilliant white stone that some say fell from the sky and came to rest in the hills over yonder. Some among my people believe that this is a tear wept from An'she, the eye of the Earth Mother herself.

I don't know if I believe that, but I do intend to see this phenomenon for myself and make my own judgement.

3325|8fca8484.name: Mirket
3325|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3464|b28a0f9e.name: Gazrog
3464|b28a0f9e.text:
The Barrens is no place for the weak, or the long-winded.  I won't waste your time with unneeded words.

I expect the same from you.

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

2-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-progress.text: Yes, mighty $c, I sensed your arrival.  I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
2-progress.title: Sharptalon's Claw

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

6284-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6284-progress.text: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.
6284-progress.title: Arachnophobia

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6421-progress.name: Mor'rogal
6421-progress.text: What news have you discovered from Boulderslide Ravine? I recall some legend that deals with Resonite... I just cannot place my hoof on it. Perhaps knowing what lies at the bottom of the cave will illuminate their devious intentions.
6421-progress.title: Boulderslide Ravine

6503-progress.name: Kuray'bin
6503-progress.text: I await reports of your outrunner kills, $N.
6503-progress.title: Ashenvale Outrunners

97538-complete.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-complete.text:
Ah, thank you, $N.

It means much to me to have you venture all the way out there for what must seem a trivial notion from an old tauren, but with your kindness I will have enough pigment for the rest of the season.

Thank you for supporting my livelihood, and I will strive to create something magnificent with the pigments you have brought.
97538-complete.title: Pigments for Paints

97538-progress.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538-progress.title: Pigments for Paints
